title: AI是创造就业的工具，软件公司不会消亡
speaker: Michael Liang

segments.en: Not anymore at the beginning yes we have no idea how the AI going to work out but now I increasingly I try to implement we try to implement AI into our own workflow in our company.
segments.zh: 现在不了。一开始我们也不知道AI会如何发展，但现在我们越来越多地在公司工作流中实施AI。

segments.en: You need someone you need specialists I mean AI actually in our opinion is a great tool actually creating jobs.
segments.zh: 你需要专家。实际上AI在我们看来是一个很好的工具，它在创造就业。

segments.en: So for software companies to totally give up their business model everyone else going to have more braze AI you need someone expert specialist in between.
segments.zh: 所以软件公司不会完全放弃商业模式，其他人会有更多AI，但中间需要专家。

segments.en: I think software do have a role in to play in that whole ecosystem in for example you know like the CRM right Salesforce right shooting at 10 times earnings.
segments.zh: 我认为软件在整个生态中确实有作用，比如CRM，Salesforce，市盈率只有10倍。

segments.en: I think if they make a proper transition using AI tools for their software business and used by the customers the corporations I think will be great business.
segments.zh: 我认为如果他们用AI工具进行适当转型，并被客户企业使用，那将是很好的业务。

segments.en: Michael just bring it back to China tech as well I mean when we look at the ecosystem even with Tencent and it's token pricing you do get the sense that they are prioritizing market share more than profits.
segments.zh: 回到中国科技，看腾讯的定价，感觉他们更优先市场份额而非利润。

segments.en: What are you seeing out there in the space that you know maybe because of valuations it looks right as a time to dip in.
segments.zh: 你在该领域看到了什么？也许因为估值，现在是介入的好时机？

segments.en: If I mean growing revenue top it is very important because overall you know the Chinese economy is not growing as fast as before so as a growth company they have to you know grow the revenue probably the first and foremost.
segments.zh: 我认为营收增长非常重要，因为整体经济增速不如以前，所以作为成长型公司，营收增长是首要任务。
